feeds.description: Read our nanny agency blog for advice, tips, and information for nannies, future nannies, and employers of nannies. A leading nanny & maternity care agency providing the highest level of service, staff, and support - Private child care in the most compliant way possible.

feeds.title: London School of Childcare Studies Blog
feeds.description: The London School of Childcare Studies, formally known as the Home Affairs Training Academy (HATA), delivers courses designed specifically for anyone working in a domestic environment such as nannies. Training includes Paediatric First Aid, OCN Common Core Skills, Maternity Nurse, Sleep Practitioner, Professional Nanny Diploma, and more. Offering work placement opportunities too. Check the blog to know more.
